 Alexander Darchiev, Russia’s ambassador to the United States, dead at 66 
 Darchiev held the position since March of last year. 
 1:57 The Russian Foreign Ministry reported that at the age of 66, the Ambassador of the Russian Federation to the United States of America, Alexander Nikitich Darchiev has passed away, Nov. 11, 2026. Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Russia By Desiree Adib November 11, 2026, 11:47 AM Share Follow ABC News on Google Alexander Darchiev, Russia’s ambassador to the United States, died Wednesday at the age of 66, according to the Russian Foreign Ministry.
 The diplomat had headed the Russian Embassy in Washington since March 2025.
 No cause of death was immediately announced. The Foreign Ministry announcement said Darchiev "passed away suddenly."
 The Russian Foreign Ministry reported that at the age of 66, the Ambassador of the Russian Federation to the United States of America, Alexander Nikitich Darchiev has passed away, Nov. 11, 2026. Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Russia The announcement called Darchiev "an outstanding diplomat, an experienced leader, a kind friend, and a mentor," as well as "a consummate professional and a brilliant expert on American affairs" who "served in one of the most critical areas of Russian foreign policy.
